description: This file defines a PHP class `Auth_Container_ADOdb` implementing storage for user authentication data using a database via the ADOdb abstraction layer. It includes methods for connecting to a database, fetching user data, listing users, adding and removing users, and manages database connection options.

classes.name: Auth_Container_ADOdb
classes.description: A PHP class implementing an authentication storage container that interacts with a database using ADOdb, supporting user fetching, listing, addition, and removal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the container with the provided DSN, setting default options and parsing the DSN.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using the provided DSN string or array.

methods.name: _prepare
methods.description: Prepares and checks the database connection, establishing it if necessary.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the connected database.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default options for database connection and table configuration.

methods.name: _parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and applies options provided in an array to configure the connection.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches user login data from the database based on username and password, verifying credentials.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users from the database.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Inserts a new user record into the database with optional additional data.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Removes a user record from the database.
